title: Tax exemption.
bodyText: The association shall be exempt from payment of all fees and all taxes levied by this State or any of its subdivisions except taxes levied on real or personal property.
bodyHtml: §431:16-114  Tax exemption.  The association shall be exempt from payment of all fees and all taxes levied by this State or any of its subdivisions except taxes levied on real or personal property. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
